items.name: Thick end
items.description: A narrow box with a fixed front panel. At the end of a run it makes the end look thick instead of 3/4".

items.name: Island back panel
items.description: A flat finished panel that covers the back of an island.

items.name: Furniture end panel
items.description: A thick, hollow end panel for the exposed end of a run, built as a frame with two dividers inside.

items.name: Base, drawer over doors with roll-outs
Base, two drawers over doors with roll-outs

notes.value: Default build: full-height doors with a skirt front, plywood, a cut-out bottom and back for plumbing, plus loose full panels to cover the side the plumbing does not come through. A false drawer front or a tip-out tray is an upgrade.

items.name: Pencil drawer
items.description: A shallow drawer box (6 1/2" high in the example) that hangs under a counter or desk.

items.name: Angled end base
items.description: An angled end cabinet: its door sits on a 45-degree face, so the run steps back at the end instead of stopping square.

notes.value: A base cabinet with a toe kick like every other base. The library template leaves the toe kick out.

items.hand_meaning: Which end of the run it finishes. The door sits on a 45-degree face.

items.name: Spice pull-out
items.description: A narrow, full-height pull-out for spices.

notes.value: A narrow, full-height door pull-out for spices.

items.name: Garbage pull-out
items.description: A drawer over a pull-out for a double garbage can.

notes.value: The handle on the pull-out front is not centred: it sits as far down from the top of the front as the handle on the middle drawer of a three-drawer bank.

items.name: Blind corner base
items.description: A blind-corner base: one door beside a fixed blind panel that tucks into the corner behind the cabinet on the other wall.
items.hand_meaning: Which side the blind (fixed) panel is on. It tucks behind the cabinet on the other wall.

items.name: Blind corner base with pull-out organizer
items.description: A blind-corner base with a pull-out corner organizer: one door beside a fixed blind panel.
items.hand_meaning: Which side the blind (fixed) panel is on.

items.name: Corner base
items.description: An L-shaped corner base with its door on the inside corner.

items.name: Corner base, adjustable shelves
items.description: The corner base with adjustable shelves instead of a fixed one.

items.name: Corner drawer base
items.description: Three drawers on the angled face of a corner cabinet. It is made in one size only.

items.name: Upper, short, no shelf
items.description: A short upper with no shelf, for example over a fridge.

items.name: Upper with under-cabinet light
items.description: An upper with an LED strip light and a light-rail panel under it.

items.name: Microwave upper
items.description: Short doors on top, and an open space below whose floor holds a microwave.

items.name: Upper corner, 45-degree
items.description: An upper corner cabinet with its door on a 45-degree face.

items.name: Upper corner
items.description: The standard upper corner cabinet. Its two sides are ideally the same length, but they can differ so the cabinets beside it measure out better.

items.name: Floating shelf
items.description: A 2"-thick floating shelf with a light rail on three sides. No box and no doors.

items.name: Open shelf end
items.description: An open, door-less shelving unit for the end of a run of uppers, with shelves that wrap around the corner.
items.hand_meaning: Which end of the run of uppers it finishes.

items.name: Upper over toilet
items.description: Doors at the top and an open shelf space at the bottom.

items.name: Mirror cabinet
items.description: A bathroom wall cabinet whose door is a mirror.

items.name: Medicine cabinet
items.description: A recessed medicine cabinet: one door and shelves.

items.name: Tall, oven opening
items.description: A drawer at the bottom, an open space for a wall oven, and doors on top.

items.name: Tall, double wall oven
items.description: Doors on top, an open space for a double wall oven, and a drawer at the bottom.

items.name: Tall, appliance stack
items.description: Doors on top, an open space for appliances, a roll-out shelf and a drawer at the bottom.

items.name: Closet tower
items.description: An open bedroom closet tower with shelves and no doors.

notes.value: Follows the kitchen sink base rules and defaults at vanity sizes: full-height doors by default, a false drawer front as an upgrade.

items.name: Furniture vanity, 2 drawers
items.description: Furniture style: a false front across the top over two drawers, legs on each side and a low shelf.

items.name: Furniture vanity, 1 drawer
items.description: Furniture style: a false front across the top over one drawer, legs on each side and an open shelf below.

items.name: Vanity sink with side drawers
items.description: A vanity sink with a bank of drawers on one side.

from_library.name: Vanity Sink plus drawers on left
Vanity Sink plus drawer on right

notes.value: This one has a false drawer front over the sink by default (only this template).

items.hand_meaning: Which side the bank of drawers is on.
